name: Undertow
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Thule Subsea: Safety Below, Parhelion's Haas-Bioroid identity, whose every steal costs the Runner a core damage unless they spend [click] and 2[credit]. Retirement Package's frame after The Automata Initiative, with two Distributed Tracing, two Djupstad Grid, two Shipment from Vladisibirsk, a Vera Ivanovna Shuyskaya and two Reaper Function for its two Brasília Government Grid, two Caveat Emptor, two Retirement Plan, two Synchrocyclotron and a Sleipnir: a steal is taxed and answered with a tag, a tag with advancement counters, and a score from Djupstad Grid's server with core damage. Standard-legal: Engineering the Future was the frame's one Core Set card. Parhelion Stage 3a: two Ontological Dependence for its two Lightning Laboratory, a 4-point requirement the core damage it deals lowers. Parhelion Stage 3b: two Hypoxia for its two Corporate Hospitality, played on the tags it gives, and two Mr. Hendrik for its two Warm Reception. Parhelion Stage 7: two Nightmare Archive for its two Working Prototype, an ambush whose core damage lowers Ontological Dependence's requirement and whose refusal costs the Runner a point. Downfall Stage 2: two Calvin B4L3Y for two Active Policing, two cards a turn that come again when the Runner trashes it, and two Red Level Clearance for two Bran 1.0, two of a draw, a gain, an install and a click.
